title: NMB. New Models Backport
description: Mod that makes a layer of compatibility between new models of minecraft 1.21.11+ for the older version. (Backport)
body:
# New Models Backport (NMB)

**New Models Backport** is a utility mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge). It allows map makers and resource pack creators to natively load and render modern JSON models (1.21.11+ format) in version 1.21.1.

It was designed for use in very specific and personal situations. (When you don't want to lug around a massive library with a ton of features just for a single function.) However, it is very simple and convenient for regular users to use.

## Key Features
* **Modern Format:** Support for block and item JSON models from the newest Minecraft versions.
* **Arbitrary Rotation:** Full support for any rotation angles generated in Blockbench (removes the 22.5° limits).
* **Fullbright:** Supports the `"ignore_light": true` property, allowing elements to render at maximum brightness while ignoring shadows and world lighting.


## Compatibility & Conflicts
Because NMB functions strictly as a format-handling library, it works seamlessly with most client and server-side modifications, including rendering optimization mods. **Currently, no conflicts with other mods have been found.**


## Example usage
```
{
  "format_version": "1.21.11", // PLEASE BE SURE TO SPECIFY THE FORMAT OF THE NEW VERSION HERE
  "ignore_light": true, // <--- GLOBAL GLOW (if placed here, the ENTIRE model will glow)
  "texture_size": [32, 32],
  "textures": {
    "texture_name": "texture_dir //minecraft:block/dirt",
    "particle": "texture_dir //minecraft:block/stone"
  },
  "elements": [
    {
      "name": "element_name",
      "ignore_light": true, // <--- LOCAL GLOW (if placed here, ONLY THIS specific element will glow)
      
      "from": ["X1", "Y1", "Z1"],
      "to": ["X2", "Y2", "Z2"],
      
      "rotation": {
        "x": "ROT_X",
        "y": "ROT_Y",
        "z": "ROT_Z",
        "origin": ["ORIGIN_X", "ORIGIN_Y", "ORIGIN_Z"]
      },
      
      "faces": {
        "north": {
          "uv": ["UV1", "UV2", "UV3", "UV4"],
          "texture": "#texture_name"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
